scientific_integrity: Forward renewal and Green kernel are prior art. Combined joint identifiability, exact local equivalence, and quadratic resolution-loss claim are supported by a self-contained proof; finite numerical diagnostics do not replace infinite proof. Independent scientific validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Compactly supported independent reset positions; one-dimensional unforced Brownian search; physical mean-time data for every point target; local ambiguity classification fixes the physical reset parameters; smooth instability family not a minimax statistical bound; possible unindexed antecedents.
title: Joint recovery and local blindness in distributed Brownian resetting
